description.text:
Internal protocol that relays org.freedesktop.ScreenSaver inhibit/uninhibit
requests between treeland and a per-user-session helper, because a
multi-user compositor does not host per-user-session D-Bus itself.

The key words "must", "must not", "required", "shall",
"shall not", "should", "should not", "recommended", "may",
and "optional" in this document are to be interpreted as
described in RFC 2119.

Warning! This protocol is EXPERIMENTAL and under active development.
It may change at any time, including in backward-incompatible ways,
without incrementing the interface major version and without prior
notice. No compatibility guarantees of any kind are provided. Clients
and compositors must track the upstream definition in treeland-protocols
and must not rely on the current interface names, requests, events, or
semantics remaining stable across releases.

This interface is an internal relay between treeland and a
privileged helper that implements the org.freedesktop.ScreenSaver
D-Bus interface. Treeland is a multi-user compositor and does not
host per-user-session D-Bus itself, so the org.freedesktop.ScreenSaver
Inhibit/UnInhibit calls are forwarded over this Wayland protocol to a
helper running in the user session, which then performs the actual
idle-inhibit bookkeeping.

Only that dedicated relay helper should bind this global. Regular
applications must NOT use this protocol to inhibit idleness; they
should use the upstream zwp_idle_inhibit_manager_v1 protocol instead,
which treeland exposes for normal clients.

The relay helper calls inhibit to register an inhibit on behalf of a
D-Bus caller and uninhibit (or disconnects the bound object) to
release it. If the bound object is destroyed, the inhibit associated
with it is automatically released. At most one inhibit is active per
bound object at a time; calling inhibit while an inhibit is already
active raises already_inhibited, and calling uninhibit with no active
inhibit raises not_yet_inhibited. Call uninhibit before inhibit to
update application_name and reason.

Destroy the bound treeland_screensaver_v2 object. Any inhibit
previously registered through this object is released as if
uninhibit had been called, and the relay helper must stop
holding the corresponding org.freedesktop.ScreenSaver inhibit on
the D-Bus caller's behalf.
Inhibit idleness with given application_name and reason_for_inhibit.
